registration.subject.note: purpose=registration; brand replacement authorized; plain text only.

registration.text.original: Your connet.ai ${purpose} code is ${code}. Requested at ${new Date(now()).toISOString()}. Enter it only on the trusted page ${email.publicOrigin} that you just opened. Do not give this code to an Agent or anyone else. It expires in 10 minutes. If you did not request this, ignore this message.
registration.text.note: purpose=registration. Map requestedAt from request timestamp, publicOrigin from configured trusted origin, minutes=10 (current source); code is a runtime parameter, never stored in the locale file. Uses up to {minutes} minutes because source line 254 caps expiry at the earlier of 10 minutes and the attempt expiry.

recovery.subject.note: purpose=password recovery; machine purpose value stays unchanged.

recoveryCompleted.text.original: Your connet.ai password was reset at ${new Date(now()).toISOString()}. If you did not request this, return to the trusted site ${sender.publicOrigin}. This message contains no password or login credential.
